_doc: Fixed question lists for light_scan.py (RIMMANDRAKE_SCAN_SCENES_AGAINST_BARS_TOGGLE_NEVER_TOGGLED; spec design/specs/2026-11-15-cheap-guards-at-every-door.md section 5). Each answer is yes, no or cannot_tell; a no cites an input line as <name>:<line>.

scene_asks_bar.text: Does the scene read, from the game, the state or event the bar promises (not only that its own orders were accepted), before any row about it can read PASS?

When the scene judges a change (something stops, fills, is coated, falls, switches), does it first check that the thing it judges actually happened or was actually present, so that nothing-happened cannot read PASS?

When the bar promises a contrast (on versus off, with versus without, before versus after), does the scene actually put the game into each of the states it compares, rather than reading one state twice?
